source.notes: ICSE 2025 board examination paper (code 'T25 501' printed on every page) from the official CISCE Archive Library bundle 'ICSE-MainExamination2025.zip' (session 'Main examination' taken from the official bundle name). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Structure: Part I (30 marks, compulsory) = Question 1 (sixteen 1-mark MCQ/assertion-reason items, [16] printed for the whole question) + Question 2 (seven 2-mark items). Part II: Section A (Questions 3-5, attempt any two) and Section B (Questions 6-10, attempt any three), each question 10 marks split 3+3+4. All Part II questions are included, so the marks in this pack add up to 110 rather than the printed maximum of 80; this is expected for a pick-2-of-3 / pick-3-of-5 paper. Items referring to a picture or headline image (1(iv), 1(x), 1(xiv), 1(xvi), 8(i)) are flagged hasFigure with LOW confidence. On pages 5 and 6 the text layer puts the item numbers (viii)-(xiii) in a separate column; each item was re-associated with its number by reading order. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper. Question text in 7 ('oppresive') and 9 ('sovereignty.A') is kept as printed.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
